purpose: To provide written consent to act as a director when appointed to hold the office of a director in a company.
who: Every person who has been appointed to hold the office of a director
when: On or before the appointment for furnishing consent to the company, and within thirty days of the appointment for filing with the Registrar.
steps: Furnish consent in writing to act as a director in Form DIR-2 on or before the appointment.
Obtain necessary security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, if the person seeking appointment is a national of a country which shares a land border with India.
File the consent with the Registrar in Form DIR-12 along with the fee within thirty days of the appointment.
checklist: Ensure Form DIR-2 is prepared in writing.
Check if the person seeking appointment is a national of a country which shares a land border with India.
Obtain security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, if applicable.
Keep Form DIR-12 ready for filing with the Registrar along with the required fee.
attachments: Security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, in case the person seeking appointment is a national of a country which shares land border with India
watch: Security clearance is mandatory if the appointee is a national of a country sharing a land border with India.
